user.title: Local monthly bills
user.description: Track monthly electricity, gas and water bills. Choose the currency used on your bills; it cannot be changed through these forms later. Records stay in HA, including statistics, sensor attributes and backups; local storage is not admin-only.

record.title: Add / correct bill
record.description:
1. Select the resource.
2. Enter its accounting month as YYYY-MM, not automatically the payment month.
3. Enter consumption (electricity: kWh; gas/water: m³) and total cost in your configured currency. Use a decimal point or comma, without thousands separators.

You will review and confirm next. Monthly bills do not provide measured daily usage.

confirm.title: Confirm bill

delete_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
delete_confirm.description:
{summary}

Confirm to remove this bill from the totals and recalculate only Energy Ledger statistics. Other integrations are not modified. A zero-valued deletion marker remains locally; this does not erase historical states or backup copies.

error.invalid_amount: Enter a number from 0 to 1,000,000,000 with at most six decimal places and 32 characters. Use a decimal point or comma, without thousands separators or scientific notation.
error.invalid_period: Enter YYYY-MM within the last 120 months, not in the future.
error.unsupported_timezone: Timezone must use a whole-hour UTC offset.

abort.no_records: There are no bills to delete.
